NEW in Phase 1. 478,234 consecutive cell-to-cell transitions from 7,985 rides -> 38,351 edges at >=2 transitions, 21,130 nodes, largest weakly-connected component 93.9%. Connectivity comes from rides, so roads nobody rode do not exist in the graph. Mean out-degree 1.82; coarsening the prefix 18->16 only reaches 1.88 for 4.4x fewer nodes, so ~1.85 is intrinsic to a road network.
